SHINDOは、福島県・会津／奥会津を拠点に、自然農法、耕作放棄地や古民家の再生: SHINDO is a project based in Aizu and Oku-Aizu, Fukushima, that builds the foundations of everyday life through natural farming, the revival of abandoned farmland and old houses, care for the natural environment, and places for learning.
会津・奥会津にねざした豊かな未来: toward an abundant future rooted in Aizu and Oku-Aizu
SHINDOは、福島県・会津／奥会津を拠点に、自然農法の確立、耕作放棄地の再生、: SHINDO is a project based in Aizu and Oku-Aizu, Fukushima, working to establish natural farming, revive abandoned farmland and old houses, care for the natural environment, and create places for learning. Food, housing, energy, health, and shared learning — we are rebuilding the foundations of life with our own hands.

なぜ暮らしの土台づくりへ？: why move to building the foundations of life?
農業を入口に、暮らしの基盤をつくり直す。: Farming is the entry point for rebuilding the basis of everyday life.
食べるもの、住む場所、使うエネルギー、健康を支える習慣、子どもと大人が学ぶ環境。: What we eat, where we live, the energy we use, the habits that keep us healthy, and the places where children and adults learn.
私たちは、暮らしを支えるものの多くを、いつの間にか遠くの仕組みに委ねるようになり: Without quite noticing, we have handed much of what sustains our lives over to distant systems.
SHINDOが目指しているのは、単に農業を大きくすることではありません。毎年実る: SHINDO is not simply trying to scale up farming. Its aim is to cultivate soil that bears fruit every year, houses that can be passed on, the wisdom to survive, and companions to build with — a foundation for life that will remain for the next generation.
国内最大のブナ帯の山間地・会津地方を拠点に、生命の基盤を、自分たちの手で創り直し: Based in the Aizu region, home to Japan's largest beech-forest highlands, we are rebuilding the foundations of life with our own hands.
暮らしてみる。: and living here as we go.

省耕起・省資源型の自然農法稲作や大豆栽培に取り組み、地域で食べ続けられる生産と備: Practice low-till, low-input natural rice and soybean farming, and build a base of production and storage so the region can keep feeding itself.
耕作放棄地、水路、森、古民家、農業倉庫を、人が再び使える場所へ戻していく。: Bring abandoned farmland, waterways, forests, old houses, and farm sheds back into use.
中山間地に合う農業機械をつくり、地域でまかなえるエネルギーや新しい暮らしの仕組み: Build farm machinery suited to hilly terrain, and test locally sourced energy and new ways of living.
援農、学生プログラム、共同生活、対話の場を通じて、子どもも大人も一緒に学び、育ち: Through farm volunteering, student programs, shared living, and dialogue, children and adults learn and grow together.

自然農法 無の会は、福島県内で最大級の有機稲作面積を担う、創業21年目の有機農場: Munokai Natural Farm, now in its 21st year, manages one of the largest areas of organic rice cultivation in Fukushima.

創業21年、県内最大規模の有機JAS農家。SHINDOの実践知の源。: Founded 21 years ago, the largest JAS-certified organic farm in the prefecture. The source of SHINDO's practical knowledge.
援農や視察を通して、土地、人、活動を知る。: Get to know the land, the people, and the work through farm volunteering or a site visit.
この村に住み、5〜10年かけて、暮らしと社会を一緒につくる。家族での移住も歓迎。: Live in this village and, over five to ten years, build a way of life and a community together. Families are welcome.
今の仕事や生活を続けながら、月1回から隔月程度、会津へ通う。: Keep your current job and life, and come to Aizu once a month or every other month.
